plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Chemistry-BS-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. Unlike the companion maps, this map DOES print parenthetical credit numbers, and they are recorded exactly as printed: B CHEM 237 (4), B CHEM 401 (4), B CHEM 402 (4), B CHEM 404 (4), B CHEM 495 (3), B CHEM 294 (1), and the Year 3-4 elective slots at (5), (5), (3), (5) and (2). Every slot without a printed parenthetical is recorded at 5 credits under the map's printed rule — including B CHEM 238, B CHEM 241, B CHEM 239 and B CHEM 242 (the organic lecture/lab sequence after B CHEM 237) and the combined '+ Lab' cells B CHEM 315 and B CHEM 426, which print no parenthetical; this follows the map's own rule and is disclosed here rather than adjusted from any other source. With the printed exceptions the quarters sum to 15/15/15, 14/15/15, 14/14/14 and 18/14/17 and the plan to exactly 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Year 4 quarters print FOUR slots each (the other quarters print three), transcribed as printed. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (no prereqs are recorded): the filled diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' (printed on the Year 1 STMATH and B CHEM cells and on B WRIT 134 and B WRIT 135); the checkmark means 'Milestones' (printed on PHYS 121/122/123, the Year 2 Autumn STMATH choice slot and B CHEM 239); the open diamond means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core' (printed on the Year 1 A&H and SSc slots). The map also prints competitive-applicant guidance (all prerequisites completed or 1-2 in progress by review, 3.0 grade or higher in each prerequisite, cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher, a positive grade trend), disclosed here and not encoded. Printed notes under the year blocks are disclosed, not encoded: 'General Chemistry III (BCHEM 163 + 164) is a prerequisite for Organic Chemistry I (BCHEM 237)'; 'Calculus I and II (STMATH 124 and 125) are prerequisites for Calculus-based Physics I and II (BPHYS 121 and 122), respectively. Organic Chemistry III and its lab (BCHEM 239 + 242) are prerequisites for most 300- and 400-level BCHEM coursework'; and 'Calculus-based Physics III and Upper Division math are prerequisites for the Physical Chemistry sequence in senior year' (the map's Year 3 note says 'senior year' although the physical chemistry courses print in Year 3 — transcribed as printed). The physics cells print 'PHYS 121/122/123' without the B prefix while the map's own Year 2 note calls them 'BPHYS 121 and 122'; the codes are recorded as printed in the cells (PHYS 121, PHYS 122, PHYS 123) with the discrepancy disclosed here. The Year 2 Autumn slot prints 'STMATH 307/308/324/341' with no title and is recorded as a choice slot with exactly those four printed options. Three printed cells combine a lecture and its lab in one slot and are folded into the lecture entry with the combination disclosed on the course title: 'B CHEM 143 + 144', 'B CHEM 153 + 154' and 'B CHEM 163 + 164' (Year 1); B CHEM 315 and B CHEM 426 print '+ Lab' in their titles and are single printed slots. The Year 4 Autumn SSc slot prints '(Diversity Requirement Course)' after SSc; that parenthetical is a designation, not a credit number, and the slot is recorded at 5 credits.
